papers.title: Contrastive Astromer: Two-Stage Contrastive Representation Learning for Astronomical Light Curve Classification
papers.summary: Two-stage unsupervised and supervised contrastive learning adapts ASTROMER 2 light-curve representations, improving macro-F1 for astronomical light-curve classification over the finetune baseline, especially with few labels.

papers.title: Beyond Point Photo-$z$ Estimates: Normalizing Flows for Tomographic $N(z)$ Reconstruction with DESI DR1
papers.summary: Conditional normalizing flows reconstruct tomographic N(z) from DESI DR1 photometry, outperforming random forests at high redshift and improving calibration.
